stem: Meridian Health tags every VPN and Direct Connect resource with a cost-center key across its AWS Organizations member accounts, but three weeks later the billing console still shows those charges as untagged, and finance wants the tag key on cost reports without re-tagging anything.

choices.text: Activate the cost-center tag key on the Billing and Cost Management cost allocation tags page
Generate a Cost and Usage Report for the management account
Turn on Reserved Instance and Savings Plans discount sharing for the organization
Apply an organization-wide tagging policy across every member account that enforces the cost-center tag on new resources

rationale: Activating the tag key in Billing and Cost Management is the step that makes an already-applied user-defined tag appear on cost reports. A Cost and Usage Report exports usage data but does not activate a tag key. Reserved Instance and Savings Plans discount sharing controls commitment-discount sharing across accounts, not tag visibility. A tagging policy can enforce the tag going forward but does not activate it for existing billing reports.
